_doc: Proxy placements given collision in full inside their box (proxy_colliders.py force, then build --force): buildings the game draws whose walls have no collision, found where the old bake's hollow fill closed space (tools/world/opened_patches.py: the drawn surface bounding the opened space with no collision, share at least 0.1). Each entry: near (x, y), box (x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1, the opened patch plus 6 m), the placements carrying at least 2% (and 100 m2) of the uncovered surface (sector, globalNodeId, mesh) and their uncovered m2. Written 2026-10-30 from the 31 building patches; entries are added or dropped by hand. Entries with wall_m2 and rays_through (2026-11-14, from proxy_colliders.py walls): walls the audit counted as covered only because the building's own roof (real collision up to 12 m over the proxy's top) is above them, with no real collision within 4 m and open air on one side; kept where at least 25% of 80 horizontal rays at the walls hit the proxy and found no collision within 4 m behind it (rays_through), and the placement has at least 100 m2 of such wall. Billboards, antennas and the stadium supports left out. walls_only: only the entry's near-vertical faces are forced.

buildings.found: by hand 2026-10-31 at (-1629.9, -1022.7, 76.0): three always drawn towers (nearAutoHideDistance 0), wall collision only below z 62; uncovered_m2 is drawn surface with no collision within 1.5 m
